Dental Scan Viewer

Runs entirely in your browser. Your scan is never uploaded.

Look inside your dental 3D scan

Dentists often hand out CBCT scans that only open in Windows software. Drop the scan's .dcm file here (or a .dcm.gz, or all of its .part files at once) and explore it on any device.

The demo is a real, anonymized dental CBCT. This tool is for curiosity, not diagnosis. Ask your dentist about anything you see. Download the offline version · Source on GitHub

Click or tap a view to move the other two to that point. Scroll over a view, or use the sliders, to step through slices.
Shift + drag to measure in mm. Alt/⌥ + drag to change brightness and contrast. ⤢ enlarges a view.
Left/right labels assume the standard radiology layout. For viewing only, not diagnosis.
